 Whether you’re looking for an SUV, MPV or compact hatchbacks, the Car Expo had them all.
 By  Cheryl Tan  -  27 Oct 2026 
 The Car Expo was back at the Singapore Expo over 24 and 25 October 2026, with over 50 brands showing off their offerings.
 Whether it was well-established Continental car brands like Audi, BMW, and Mercedez-Benz, or up-and-coming Chinese brands like AVATR, Dongfeng, iCaur, and CHANGAN, there was plenty to see at the show. Check out our full walkthrough video above and further highlights below.
 The iCaur V23 was one of the most stylish cars on display there, with styling cues taken from the Mercedes-Benz G-Wagon and Land Rover Defender. The 100kW output qualifies it for a Cat A COE and the car gets up to 312km of range, with a 30-80% charge supposed to take just 30 minutes.
 The Honda Super One EV was another interesting car at the show. This compact car is designed to be fun to drive, with a boost mode that simulates engine noise and gearshifts like a regular ICE car, handled by the paddle shifters that also control regenerative braking levels when driving in normal mode.
 Aside from the plethora of cars on display, the Car Expo was joined by the brand-new Lifestyle Edit 2026 expo, with brands like BBYEOL, Ruhens, Simba, Interdesk and more showcasing their lifestyle products.
